viral_fraction_detected: Non-host read fraction after k-mer-based binning
main_strength: Fast k-mer-based binning
main_limitation: Performance depends on reference composition and parameterization; less independently benchmarked in viromics than major aligners
unsupported_or_weak_claim: Proof that retained reads are non-human or that removed reads are exclusively host-derived
key_parameters: Reference k-mer length and matching stringency
quality_or_detection_threshold: Study-specific; benchmark against representative host and viral reads

viral_fraction_detected: Reads mapping to the human reference
main_strength: High precision and configurable sensitivity
main_limitation: High-sensitivity modes increase runtime; reference and pairing choices affect removal
unsupported_or_weak_claim: Guaranteed privacy or complete preservation of virus-like host sequences
key_parameters: Very-sensitive-local or benchmarked equivalent; paired/unpaired handling
quality_or_detection_threshold: Report alignment mode, reference version, retained pairs, and residual-host assessment

viral_fraction_detected: Reads aligning to the human reference
main_strength: Fast alignment across read lengths
main_limitation: Sensitivity depends on preset and reference; host-like viral sequence may be removed
best_use: Fast host depletion, including long reads
unsupported_or_weak_claim: Complete removal of identifiable human sequence without residual-risk assessment
key_parameters: Use -sr for short genomic reads; appropriate long-read preset
quality_or_detection_threshold: Report preset, reference, secondary alignment handling, and pair policy
evidence_status: Used within Hostile; independent context-specific benchmarking needed

viral_fraction_detected: Non-host reads after masked-reference alignment
reference_database: Masked human reference including T2T/HLA resources
main_strength: High host-read removal with strong microbial-read retention
main_limitation: Still depends on reference masking and cannot preserve every host-like viral signal
unsupported_or_weak_claim: Detection of endogenous viral elements after strict host removal
key_parameters: Choose appropriate short- or long-read mode and host reference
quality_or_detection_threshold: Report database release and retained/removed fractions

viral_fraction_detected: Reads retained after NCBI-compatible scrubbing
main_strength: Operationally aligned with SRA public-deposition screening
main_limitation: Not optimized to retain every microbial or host-like viral read
unsupported_or_weak_claim: Biologically neutral host depletion
key_parameters: Default/current NCBI workflow; record version
quality_or_detection_threshold: Must still evaluate impact on endogenous or host-similar viruses

viral_fraction_detected: Reads classified or filtered as selected taxa
main_strength: Containerized, reproducible taxon-removal workflow
main_limitation: Recall and false-positive balance depends strongly on database and chained passes
unsupported_or_weak_claim: Universally optimal host removal
key_parameters: Record selected modules, databases and pass order
quality_or_detection_threshold: Report recall/precision benchmark relevant to specimen and database

viral_fraction_detected: Reads assigned to database taxa with coverage filters
specimen_context: Developed for human gut; validate elsewhere
main_strength: Coverage-aware profiling improves specificity over raw read counts
main_limitation: Cannot discover viruses absent from the reference; database composition controls labels
unsupported_or_weak_claim: Confirmation of a novel virus or complete genome recovery
key_parameters: Use documented coverage thresholds and report database version
quality_or_detection_threshold: Require adequate breadth, depth and control comparison

viral_fraction_detected: k-mer-assigned sequences
main_strength: Very fast and scalable
main_limitation: Closely related taxa and database contamination can generate false positives; raw counts do not establish genome coverage
unsupported_or_weak_claim: Species confirmation from a few reads
key_parameters: Confidence threshold and database must be reported
quality_or_detection_threshold: Support calls with breadth of coverage and controls
evidence_status: Extensively benchmarked generally; human-virome-specific calibration limited

viral_fraction_detected: Assembled contigs from mixed communities
main_strength: Widely used de novo assembler for complex communities
main_limitation: Microdiversity, repeats and uneven coverage fragment or collapse viral genomes
best_use: General short-read metagenome assembly before viral calling
unsupported_or_weak_claim: Proof that a contig is viral or non-chimeric
key_parameters: Use multiple k-mers and retain assembly graph
quality_or_detection_threshold: Evaluate read support, coverage, graph structure and chimerism

viral_fraction_detected: Assembled contigs from mixed communities
main_strength: Fast and memory-efficient for large datasets
main_limitation: Does not eliminate fragmentation, collapse or chimeric assembly risks
unsupported_or_weak_claim: Independent confirmation of viral origin
key_parameters: Report k-mer series and minimum contig length
quality_or_detection_threshold: Validate viral contigs by mapping, callers and genome-quality analysis

viral_fraction_detected: Sequences supported by marker and neural-network branches
specimen_context: Broad; performance depends on represented groups
primary_output: Virus/plasmid classifications, provirus regions and taxonomy
main_strength: Integrated marker, gene-content and neural-network evidence
main_limitation: Short or atypical elements may lack decisive features; taxonomy is often above species level
best_use: General viral contig and provirus identification
unsupported_or_weak_claim: Experimental function, infectivity or artifact-free assembly
key_parameters: Record database release and score filters
quality_or_detection_threshold: Combine classification score with hallmark genes, quality and read support

viral_target: Multiple DNA and RNA viral groups
viral_fraction_detected: Contigs with group-specific viral feature support
specimen_context: Broad; tune viral groups to study
primary_output: Viral candidate contigs, scores and features
main_strength: Multi-classifier framework across diverse viral groups
main_limitation: False positives increase without post-filtering; performance varies by group and contig length
best_use: Sensitive candidate discovery followed by quality control
unsupported_or_weak_claim: Automatic confirmation that every score-positive contig is viral
key_parameters: Select relevant viral groups and apply recommended SOP
quality_or_detection_threshold: Use post-filtering, hallmark genes and CheckV or equivalent

viral_fraction_detected: Contigs with protein-signature and learned viral features
primary_output: Viral calls, boundaries and functional annotations
main_strength: Combines viral identification with protein annotation
main_limitation: Database and training representation affect sensitivity; functional calls remain putative
unsupported_or_weak_claim: Validated biological function or infectivity
key_parameters: Report version, databases and minimum contig criteria
quality_or_detection_threshold: Require genome-level and read-support validation
evidence_status: Primary method paper; independent comparisons available

viral_target: Viruses represented by learned sequence patterns
viral_fraction_detected: Sequences with high neural-network viral scores
main_strength: Alignment-free detection of divergent and shorter sequences
main_limitation: Probabilistic score is sensitive to training data, length and atypical cellular sequences
best_use: Prioritizing divergent candidates for multi-evidence review
unsupported_or_weak_claim: Standalone confirmation of a novel virus
key_parameters: Apply length-aware significance thresholds
quality_or_detection_threshold: Retain scores but require independent genomic evidence
evidence_status: Primary method paper; independent comparisons available

viral_fraction_detected: Quality-assessed viral genomes
main_strength: Standardized estimates and host-boundary support
main_limitation: Novel groups may receive uncertain completeness estimates; not a viral detector
best_use: Post-identification genome quality and provirus assessment
unsupported_or_weak_claim: Proof of infectivity or taxonomic identity
key_parameters: Report database version and quality categories
quality_or_detection_threshold: Interpret alongside contig length, read support and genome architecture

viral_fraction_detected: ANI-based groupings of supplied viral sequences
main_strength: Fast large-scale ANI and clustering
main_limitation: Cluster quality depends on input completeness, alignment coverage and thresholds
unsupported_or_weak_claim: Formal taxonomy or biological equivalence without supporting evidence
key_parameters: Report ANI and alignment-fraction thresholds
quality_or_detection_threshold: Use quality-aware inputs and sensitivity analyses

viral_fraction_detected: Predicted prokaryotic host taxon
reference_database: iPHoP host genome and model databases
primary_output: Host predictions with scores and methods
main_strength: Integrates multiple host-prediction signals
main_limitation: Accuracy and taxonomic resolution vary; database coverage limits hosts
unsupported_or_weak_claim: Confirmed infection, productive replication or strain-level host without validation
key_parameters: Report database version, confidence and contributing signals
quality_or_detection_threshold: Prefer agreement with direct CRISPR/prophage evidence or experiments

input_type: Predicted or experimental protein structures; optionally sequences
viral_fraction_detected: Proteins with detectable structural similarity
reference_database: Selected structure databases and release dates
main_strength: Sensitive remote-homology search beyond sequence similarity
main_limitation: A structural match does not prove exact function, viral origin or contig authenticity
best_use: Hypothesis generation for viral protein dark matter
unsupported_or_weak_claim: Experimentally validated function from structure alone
key_parameters: Report database, coverage, E-value and structural score
quality_or_detection_threshold: Require confident structure plus match coverage and genomic context
evidence_status: Primary method paper; broad structural benchmarking

viral_fraction_detected: Proteins with predictable folded domains
specimen_context: Broad; difficult for short, disordered or unusual proteins
main_strength: Provides structural hypotheses for proteins lacking homologs
main_limitation: pLDDT measures local structural confidence, not functional correctness; disordered regions may remain unresolved
unsupported_or_weak_claim: Validated function, viral origin or biological activity
key_parameters: Interpret pLDDT per residue; report model/version and coverage
quality_or_detection_threshold: Separate structure confidence from match and function confidence
evidence_status: Extensively benchmarked structurally; viral function requires additional evidence

viral_fraction_detected: Predicted phage genes with database matches
main_strength: Rapid standardized phage annotation
main_limitation: Unknown proteins remain hypothetical; annotations inherit database errors
unsupported_or_weak_claim: Experimental confirmation of gene function
key_parameters: Report database and caller versions
quality_or_detection_threshold: Use confidence labels and orthogonal evidence for key functions
evidence_status: Primary method paper; independent benchmarking limited
